profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer with 16+ years of experience delivering and modernizing software across cloud, web, desktop, and distributed systems. I’ve had the opportunity to work on products and platforms at different stages from building new capabilities to improving reliability, performance, and maintainability in long‑lived systems.

I partner closely with product, architecture, and engineering teams to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, with a focus on clarity, risk reduction, and sustainable delivery. I care deeply about strong engineering practices, thoughtful system design, and enabling teams through collaboration and mentorship.

My background includes full‑stack development and platform modernization, with deep experience in C#, .NET, RESTful APIs, and data‑driven systems.

positions.title: Lead Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
OPAL System
•	Developing and maintaining a system which efficiently manages order processing, shipping labels, accounting entries, marketplace portals using C# .Net, MVC, Entity Framework, MS SQL, HTML5, CSS3.
•	Mapping, integration and support of X12 and EDI standards over various protocols including FTP, FTPS, SFTP, and AS2.
•	Integration with various shipping carriers including FedEx, UPS, Stamps.com/USPS, DHL to provide rate info, generate shipping and tracking labels, track shipments, validate addresses.
•	Integration with Quickbooks for maintaining invoices, sales orders, item/inventory, customers using Quickbooks API.
•	Developed various multi-threaded windows services which perform specific tasks in the order fulfillment process in real time.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Click2Chat Application
•	Developed a customer service oriented chat application using Flash Develop IDE to simulate different chat scenarios.
•	Created an evaluation module to evaluate the user of the application based on the quality of service provided to the customer.
•	Integrated chat scenarios and evaluation modules into an ActionScript 3 based flash application.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: Design and development of web application using Ext JS (Sencha), XHTML at the front end and MySQL, JDBC, JSP/Servlet, Hibernate/Spring Framework for the back end.
